values.products-description:
A reading light that clips to a book cover, a shelf or the edge of a bunk and bends its neck to where the page is. The warm 2700 K light is dimmable in three steps and never glares off paper.

The clip is lined with soft silicone so it will not mark a cover. It charges over USB-C and lasts twenty evenings of an hour each.

This batch is gone. We are waiting on new clips that grip thicker shelves.

products-spec.products-spec-care: Wipe clean; avoid bending the neck past 90°
products-spec.products-spec-material: ABS body; silicone-lined clip; steel gooseneck

values.products-subtitle: A small clip-on light with a flexible neck for books and bunks.
